

```{r}
op = setwd("inst/extdata/deploy_plumber")
update_manifest()
setwd(op)

op = setwd("inst/extdata/check_sys_deps/")
update_manifest()
setwd(op)


update_manifest = function() {
  renv::init(repos = c("CRAN" = "https://cloud.r-project.org/"))
  renv::install(c("rsconnect", "plumber"), prompt = FALSE)

  rsconnect::writeManifest()
  fs::dir_delete("renv")
  fs::file_delete("renv.lock")
  fs::file_delete(".Rprofile")
}
```
